description: This Java class 'NextWordsFileParserV1' handles reading and writing a custom binary file format for storing next-word suggestions, including methods for loading stored next words from an InputStream and storing next words to an OutputStream. It implements the 'NextWordsFileParser' interface and manages serialization/deserialization of 'NextWordsContainer' objects.

classes.name: NextWordsFileParserV1
classes.description: A parser class for reading and writing a custom binary format for next-word suggestions, version 1.

methods.name: loadStoredNextWords
methods.description: Loads next-word suggestions from an InputStream, returning an iterable of NextWordsContainer objects.

methods.name: readWord
methods.description: Reads a UTF-8 encoded word from the InputStream into a buffer, returning the word as a String or null if reading fails.

methods.name: storeNextWords
methods.description: Stores a collection of NextWordsContainer objects into an OutputStream in a custom binary format.

methods.name: writeWord
methods.description: Writes a UTF-8 encoded word to an OutputStream, preceded by its length.
